title: TheySix event server announced
summary: A new Java and Bedrock event server was revealed after weeks of development.
description: The management and staff team announced a sponsored Minecraft event server, initially focused on special events with the possibility of expanding in the future.

body.text: The server was planned for event-focused gameplay, with a Hunger Games-style concept among the first ideas being prepared.
The event server was being built to support both Java and Bedrock players.
If the events performed well, a future always-online survival server was considered as a possibility.
